newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stad Rotterdam issues shares for takeover.
newsitem.headline: Stad Rotterdam issues shares for takeover.

text.p: Stad Rotterdam said it would issue about 1.4 million new shares to finance part of the takeover of the remaining stake in fellow-insurer De Amersfoortse Verzekeringsgroep NV.
Stad Rotterdam said in April it expected to reach agreement with Muenchener Rueckversicherung and Nuernberger Beteiligungs AG to buy their stakes in Amersfoortse of 25 and 20 percent respectively.
Stad Rotterdam, which already owned 55 percent of Amersfoortse, said the value of the 45 percent interest had been established at about 400 million guilders.
The deal would also be partly financed in cash from Stad Rotterdam's existing liquid assets, the Dutch group said.
After the deal, Muenchener Rueckversicherung will hold an interest of about 12 percent in the combination of Stad Rotterdam and Amersfoortse.
Nuernberger Beteiligungs AG will not have a stake in the merged company but will remain linked through a cooperation agreement.
Stad Rotterdam reiterated that the acquisition of the remaining shares in Amersfoortse is expected to have a positive effect on its earnings per share.
Medium-sized Stad Rotterdam posted 1996 profit of 156.9 million guilders, up from 133.4 million in the previous year, on total turnover of 4.5 billion guilders.
Amersfoortse previously said it expected its 1996 net profit to be about 15 percent higher than 1995's 53.2 million guilders on turnover of 1.15 billion.
